editorial: Today, security audit tools and robotic systems that adapt to physical environments (embodied agents) are coming to the forefront in the software world. In addition to high-performance models like DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, projects that optimize local data access are on developers' radars.

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.summary: Developed by Cloudflare, security-audit-skill is a capability package that transforms AI coding agents into auditors capable of performing multi-stage security audits. It manages discovery, vulnerability scanning, and independent verification processes to generate standardized security reports.

snapshot.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings. A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting.

items.title: php/php-src
items.summary: PHP is a general-purpose scripting language designed specifically for web development processes. Written in the C language, this interpreter powers a large portion of websites worldwide.

snapshot.description: The PHP Interpreter. PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that is especially suited to web development. Fast, flexible and pragmatic, PHP powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world.

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.summary: The knowledge-work-plugins released by Anthropic include open-source plugins that enable knowledge workers to perform specialized tasks on Claude Cowork and Claude Code. These Python-based tools aim to transform the AI model into an assistant tailored to users' own roles, teams, and companies.

snapshot.description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork. Plugins that turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Built for Claude Cowork, also compatible with Claude Code.

items.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
items.summary: Developed by NVIDIA, OpenShell offers a secure and privacy-focused runtime environment for autonomous AI agents. Written in Rust, this tool restricts agents' capabilities, such as file reading or using digital bridges (APIs), to ensure the protection of data and the network.

snapshot.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents. OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents. Agents are most useful when they can read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials. OpenShell gives them that capability without giving them unrestricted access to your data, secrets, or network. You declare what each agent can touch in a policy, and OpenShell enforces it.

items.title: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu
items.summary: Renhuai123/ziwei-doushu is an open-source TypeScript engine based on Ni Haixia's Tianji system that calculates Ziwei Doushu astrological charts. The project provides a large 13-dimensional astrological interpretation dataset (v4.0) covering dates between 1950 and 2026.

snapshot.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据. 1. 发布 13 维解读数据集 v4.0 —— 674,976 张命盘（公历 1950–2026 年每一个真实日期 × 12 时辰 × 男女）× 13 维 = 8,774,688 段解读，正文约 204 亿字。解压后 56.6 GB（v3.0 为 33.1 GB，增加 71%），压缩后只有 161 MB，按年份分 77 个文件，可以只下需要的年份，也可以一次下全年份总包。下载见 Release v4.0-13d，规格和字段见第二·新章。发布前 77 个文件逐个解压，与原始数据逐字节比对一致。

items.title: SnailSploit/Claude-Red
items.summary: SnailSploit/Claude-Red is an offensive security skills library prepared for the Claude AI capability system. It provides expert methodologies for various attack surfaces, such as SQL injection and shellcode development, through structured files.

snapshot.description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.

items.title: OpenBMB/VoxCPM
items.summary: Developed by OpenBMB, VoxCPM produces continuous speech representations directly in text-to-speech (TTS) processes thanks to its tokenizer-free structure. With its end-to-end diffusion autoregressive architecture, it offers multilingual speech generation, creative sound design, and realistic voice cloning capabilities.

snapshot.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning. VoxCPM is a tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech system that directly generates continuous speech representations via an end-to-end diffusion autoregressive architecture, bypassing discrete tokenization to achieve highly natural and expressive synthesis.

items.title: nodejs/node
items.summary: Node.js is an open-source (source code accessible to everyone) runtime environment that allows JavaScript code to be executed outside the browser. This infrastructure, which can run on different operating systems, is widely preferred for server-side application development.

snapshot.description: Node.js JavaScript runtime ✨🐢🚀✨. Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment.

items.title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
items.summary: Local Wikipedia is an encyclopedia project that provides information about places within a half-hour walking distance of the user's current location. Aiming to increase environmental awareness, this platform scales general Wikipedia content down to a local level.

snapshot.description: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
items.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed are among generative AI models. These models offer up-to-date options designed for users to perform complex tasks.

snapshot.description: https://www.kimi.com/code/docs/en/kimi-code/models.htmlhttps://artificialanalysis.ai/models/kimi-k3-1-prohttps://www.modelcompare.ai/blog/china-open-source-ai

items.title: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone
items.summary: Security researchers announced that they have successfully completed a hack they aimed to perform on an iPhone. This study refers to a technical process conducted regarding the smartphone's security vulnerabilities.

snapshot.description: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone.

items.title: Apple Music 404 Not Found
items.summary: A hidden error page has been discovered on the website of the Apple Music digital music platform. The 404 page in question presents a different design for links that users cannot access.

snapshot.description: https://www.macrumors.com/2026/10/23/apple-music-has-a-hidde...

items.title: Canadians are running out of time to oppose Bill C-22
items.summary: The bill codenamed Bill C-22, currently being discussed in the Canadian Parliament, has the potential to threaten the privacy and security rights of millions by expanding surveillance powers. There is limited time left for public reaction against the lawful access regulation, which has passed the House of Commons and is currently on the agenda of the Canadian Senate.

snapshot.description: Canada’s Parliament is debating a massive expansion of surveillance powers that will threaten the privacy and security of millions of people. Bill C-22, also called the Lawful Access Act, has already passed the House of Commons, and is now before the Canadian Senate. Canadians still have an...

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is an artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text-based inputs. Offering improvements in reasoning, coding, and agent-based tasks, this version aims to increase cost efficiency by reducing processing time and output length.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance–cost Pareto frontier across multiple agent harnesses.

items.title: RecursiveSI/flint
items.summary: RecursiveSI/flint is a text generation model with a mixture-of-experts architecture developed for coding agents. Containing a total of 39.8 billion parameters, the model is designed to examine codebases, debug, add new features, and write tests.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Flint is Recursive’s mixture-of-experts language model for coding agents, with 39.8 billion total parameters and approximately 2.5 billion active per token. It is designed to investigate codebases, fix bugs, implement features, and write tests.

items.title: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy
items.summary: Developed by Black Forest Labs, flux-3-image-klein-comfy is an artificial intelligence model that provides image-to-image conversion. This model is designed to run on the ComfyUI image generation interface.

snapshot.description: image-to-image model

items.title: OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-SFT
items.summary: Developed by the OpenMOSS-Team, MOSS-Image-SFT is a supervised fine-tuned model with text-to-image generation capabilities. Supporting natural language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON schemas that control text placement and object layout, this model is built on the MOSS-Image-Base architecture.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. MOSS-Image-SFT is a supervised fine-tuned text-to-image model in the MOSS-Image family from OpenMOSS, derived from MOSS-Image-Base. It uses the same architecture and inference pipeline, supporting natural-language prompts, tag sequences, and JSON layouts for controlling text placement and object arrangement.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: LTX-2.5, developed by Lightricks, is an artificial intelligence model that converts images to video (image-to-video model). It offers users the ability to create moving videos from static content.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
items.summary: TARSphere is a full-stack framework developed for robotic agents moving under physical and social constraints. Operating on a physics simulator, the system aims for robots to adapt to changing environmental conditions and human needs with long-term goals.

snapshot.description: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue.

items.title: The LLM-Attacker: A Unified Red-Team Framework for Privacy Evaluation of Split and Distributed LLM Systems
items.summary: The LLM-Attacker provides a unified red-team framework for the privacy assessment of split and distributed large language model (LLM) systems. It aims to standardize data recovery processes by allowing researchers to record, compare, and extend different attack methods.

snapshot.description: Split language models keep input text on a client but send intermediate representations to a server. Attacks can reconstruct text from these messages. Comparing privacy evaluations is difficult when attackers see different messages, know different model weights or use different datasets and recovery measures. We present LLM-Attacker, a framework that records these choices and lets researchers check, compare and extend an evaluation. Compatible attacks reuse recorded messages, and their predictio

items.title: EvalResearchBench: Can AI Agents Build Their Own Feedback for Recursive Self-Improvement?
items.summary: EvalResearchBench is a benchmark tool that investigates whether artificial intelligence agents can autonomously design the evaluation mechanisms they need for recursive self-improvement processes. This study aims to automate evaluation processes using software interfaces (APIs) to reduce the cost of complex tests.

snapshot.description: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) relies on evaluation feedback to assess progress and guide further research, yet repeatedly running complex benchmarks is costly and slows iteration. Human experts reduce this cost by selecting benchmark subsets or designing compact suites. We ask whether AI agents can automate this design process and introduce EvalResearchBench (ERB), a benchmark for autonomous evaluation research. items.title: Diffusion Language Models Change Speed Across Tasks and Languages
items.summary: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens in a single forward pass, dynamically determining the number of steps in the generation process based on the tasks. Research shows that tasks where input text is copied or edited are lower cost, while free-text generation is higher cost.

snapshot.description: Diffusion language models can write several tokens in one forward pass, and they decide during generation how many passes to spend. Two outputs of the same token length can therefore vary a lot in cost. To understand the underlying factors of this cost variation, we analyze two diffusion models across 10 tasks. items.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: T 2Quant, developed for Diffusion Language Models (DLMs), reveals that quantization precision in the iterative denoising process varies according to task and time variables. This method offers a mixed-precision quantization strategy by predicting the precision requirements needed by different tasks without requiring label data.

snapshot.description: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) introduce unique quantization challenges due to their iterative denoising process. In this work, we reveal that quantization sensitivity is both taskand time-dependent, with different downstream tasks exhibiting distinct precision requirements across denoising steps. We further show that these patterns can be predicted without groundtruth labels or task-specific evaluation metrics. glossary.explanation: A programming language used to automate complex software processes, typically written faster and executed by an interpreter.
A type of software whose source code is open for anyone to inspect, modify, and improve.
A system that provides the resources and environment required for software to run.
A digital bridge that enables different software applications to exchange data and communicate with each other.
A version number indicating that a piece of software or dataset has been developed to reach its fourth major release.
Offensive security capabilities used to find weaknesses in systems and test those vulnerabilities.
A small piece of machine code used to execute commands by exploiting security vulnerabilities in systems.
A structure that processes data directly as a continuous stream without breaking the text into small pieces.
Technology that converts written text into human speech via a computer.
An architecture used for audio or image generation that makes sequential predictions by creating data from noise.
A software environment that contains the libraries and system resources necessary for a program to run.
Artificial intelligence capable of generating new content such as text, images, or audio based on data it has been previously trained on.
An architecture that increases efficiency by dividing a large model into smaller sub-sections, each specialized in different tasks.
An artificial intelligence process that takes an image as input and transforms it into a different style or content.
An artificial intelligence capability that analyzes written prompts and generates images suitable for them.
A specialized training process performed on a pre-trained model using labeled data to achieve better results in specific tasks.
